description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pahala Makandura, Pannala D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420500
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including details of land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and encumbrances. The content is focused on land registration and property ownership matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
